title: RuntimeClass
description: platform.runtime-class@1: the kind of execution environment a platform.job@1 asks for (plan T14 Run; ADR-034 proposed). A name only: this contract defines no behavior, and a worker runs only the classes it advertises and refuses every other one (`nack`). `function` is the first class implemented (OpenVibe.Node's function worker); the others are reserved names.
$comment: Additive: a class may be added to v1; none is removed, renamed or reordered.

oneOf.description: A pre-registered artifact (name and exact version) run once with declared args to one result: single-shot, no persistent filesystem, no dependency resolution, network denied.
Arbitrary source with its dependency tree in a longer-lived environment; needs image handling and isolation stronger than a container.
A headless or headed web browser session driven remotely.
A full Linux environment (shell, filesystem, processes) that lives across commands.
A graphical desktop session with screen and input under control levels.
A workload that holds one or more GPUs for its lifetime.
